1	extends SceneTree
2	## A7 Step 5, plan step 1: supplemental timing probe (CHANGE-BRIEF.md Revision 1, "Evidence split").
3	## Not counted. Never loads or instantiates the game. Each run instantiates its own copy of
4	## player_visuals.tscn under a stand-in parent (Node2D, physics priority 0, the way Player will sit above
5	## PlayerVisuals) and a late hook (Node, physics priority 1000, the pattern of TickHook in test_a7_pins.gd).
6	## The stand-in's _physics_process makes the scheduled AnimationPlayer calls (play / seek / pause), where
7	## player.gd will make them; nothing else in this probe calls playback. No clip is built, keyed or
8	## modified: the probe only reads clip values (value_track_interpolate) for the expected rig values.
9	## Headless: positions and node properties are read; nothing is drawn. Scripted calls, not a playtest.
10	## Engine behaviour that differs from the plan's assumptions is a finding (printed), not a failure.
11	## Exit 1 only if the probe itself cannot run (missing scene, node, clip or track; a tick not logged).
12	##
13	## Per tick: EARLY = current_animation_position read in the stand-in before any call that tick;
14	## MID = read right after the call (call ticks only); LATE = read in the late hook, after the stand-in
15	## and the AnimationPlayer have both updated that tick.
16	
17	const SCENE_PATH := "res://features/player/player_visuals.tscn"
18	const LOWER_SCALE_PATH := "FacingPivot/LandRig/LowerPivot:scale"
19	const UPPER_POS_PATH := "FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot:position"
20	const UPPER_SCALE_PATH := "FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot:scale"
21	const F := 1.0 / 60.0
22	const PRE := 3            # stand-in ticks before entry (n = 0 is the entry tick)
23	## Hand-off runs (prompt-5d): land is entered at n = LAND_ENTRY_N with play + seek(0, true), the way
24	## player.gd enters it on touchdown, so at n = -1 it shows 7/60 (land_ticks = 1), the tick before the
25	## game's tick-8 LAND -> SCOOT hand-off. On n = 0 the stand-in switches to scoot at k/60 with H0, H1 or H2.
26	const HANDOFF_PRE := 10   # stand-in ticks before the hand-off tick in hand-off runs
27	const LAND_ENTRY_N := -8
28	const PAUSE_LEN := 10     # paused ticks: n = p .. p + PAUSE_LEN - 1; resume on n = p + PAUSE_LEN
29	const SCOOT_TICKS := 32   # SCOOT ticks logged from entry (and again from a resume): more than two cycles
30	const POST := 2           # LAND ticks logged after the expected time reaches 8/60 (informational)
31	const TOL_T := 1e-6
32	const TOL_V := 1e-4
33	
34	class StandIn extends Node2D:
35		## Stands in for Player (priority 0, parent of PlayerVisuals).
36		var s := 0
37		var on_tick: Callable
38		func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
39			on_tick.call(s)
40			s += 1
41	
42	class TickHook extends Node:
43		## Priority 1000: runs after the stand-in and the AnimationPlayer in every physics tick.
44		var on_tick: Callable
45		func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
46			on_tick.call()
47	
48	var hook: TickHook
49	var harness_failed := false
50	
51	# Current run
52	var spec: Dictionary = {}
53	var run_id := ""
54	var active := false
55	var done := false
56	var stand: StandIn
57	var visuals: Node2D
58	var ap: AnimationPlayer
59	var scoot_sprite: Sprite2D
60	var lower: Node2D
61	var upper: Node2D
62	var land_anim: Animation
63	var scoot_len := 0.0
64	var tr_lower := -1
65	var tr_upos := -1
66	var tr_uscale := -1
67	var cur_n := -999
68	var early_stamp := -1
69	var early := NAN
70	var early_playing := false
71	var mid := NAN
72	var mid_frame := -1
73	var mid_lower := Vector2(NAN, NAN)
74	var call_name := "-"
75	var rows: Array[Dictionary] = []
76	var pre_cur := ""         # hand-off runs: current_animation at LATE on n = -1
77	var pre_late := NAN       # hand-off runs: current_animation_position at LATE on n = -1
78	
79	# Totals
80	var runs_done := 0
81	var ticks_logged := 0
82	var method_agg: Dictionary = {}
83	var a1_counts: Dictionary = {}
84	var entry_adv: Dictionary = {}
85	var resume_adv: Dictionary = {}
86	var pf6: Dictionary = {}
87	var handoff_fail_k: Dictionary = {}   # method -> ["k=<k> first_n=<n>", ...] for failing hand-off runs
88	
89	func _initialize() -> void:
90		call_deferred("run")
91	
92	func harness_fail(msg: String) -> void:
93		harness_failed = true
94		print("PROBE HARNESS FAIL: " + msg)
95	
96	func v2s(v: Vector2) -> String:
97		return "(%.6f,%.6f)" % [v.x, v.y]
98	
99	func pos_now() -> float:
100		if ap == null or String(ap.assigned_animation) == "":
101			return NAN
102		return ap.current_animation_position
103	
104	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- schedule and expectations
105	
106	func pause_at() -> int:
107		return int(spec["pause"])
108	
109	func is_handoff() -> bool:
110		return bool(spec.get("handoff", false))
111	
112	func pre_ticks() -> int:
113		return HANDOFF_PRE if is_handoff() else PRE
114	
115	func logical_c(n: int) -> int:
116		## Active ticks since entry. Frozen at the last active tick while paused.
117		var p := pause_at()
118		if p < 0 or n < p:
119			return n
120		if n < p + PAUSE_LEN:
121			return p - 1
122		return n - PAUSE_LEN
123	
124	func phase(n: int) -> int:
125		return int(spec["k"]) + logical_c(n)
126	
127	func tick_paused(n: int) -> bool:
128		var p := pause_at()
129		return p >= 0 and n >= p and n < p + PAUSE_LEN
130	
131	func expected_time(n: int) -> float:
132		if spec["clip"] == "scoot":
133			return float(posmod(phase(n), 14)) / 60.0
134		return float(mini(phase(n), 8)) / 60.0
135	
136	func counted(n: int) -> bool:
137		return spec["clip"] == "scoot" or phase(n) <= 8
138	
139	func last_n() -> int:
140		var extra := PAUSE_LEN if pause_at() >= 0 else 0
141		if spec["clip"] == "scoot":
142			var from := (pause_at() + PAUSE_LEN) if pause_at() >= 0 else 0
143			return from + SCOOT_TICKS - 1
144		return (8 - int(spec["k"])) + extra + POST
145	
146	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- per-tick work
147	
148	func enter(t: float) -> void:
149		var clip := StringName(spec["clip"])
150		match spec["method"]:
151			"R1":
152				ap.play(clip)
153				ap.seek(t, true)
154			"R2":
155				ap.play(clip)
156				ap.seek(t, false)
157			"R3":
158				ap.play(clip)
159			# Hand-off from a playing land clip to scoot in one tick (prompt-5d).
160			"H0":
161				ap.stop()
162				ap.play(clip)
163				ap.seek(t, true)
164			"H1":
165				ap.stop(true)
166				ap.play(clip)
167				ap.seek(t, true)
168			"H2":
169				ap.play(clip)
170				ap.seek(t, true)
171	
172	func _stand_tick(s: int) -> void:
173		if not active:
174			return
175		cur_n = s - pre_ticks()
176		early_stamp = Engine.get_physics_frames()
177		early = pos_now()
178		early_playing = ap.is_playing()
179		call_name = "-"
180		var p := pause_at()
181		if is_handoff() and cur_n == LAND_ENTRY_N:
182			ap.play(&"land")
183			ap.seek(0.0, true)
184		if cur_n == 0:
185			enter(float(spec["k"]) * F)
186			call_name = "entry"
187		elif p >= 0 and cur_n == p:
188			ap.pause()
189			call_name = "pause"
190		elif p >= 0 and cur_n == p + PAUSE_LEN:
191			enter(expected_time(cur_n))
192			call_name = "resume"
193		if call_name != "-":
194			mid = pos_now()
195			mid_frame = scoot_sprite.frame
196			mid_lower = lower.scale
197		else:
198			mid = NAN
199			mid_frame = -1
200			mid_lower = Vector2(NAN, NAN)
201	
202	func _late_tick() -> void:
203		if active and not done and is_handoff() and cur_n == -1:
204			pre_cur = String(ap.current_animation)
205			pre_late = pos_now()
206		if not active or done or cur_n < 0:
207			return
208		var tick := Engine.get_physics_frames()
209		if early_stamp != tick:
210			harness_fail("stand-in did not run on physics tick %d (run %s)" % [tick, run_id])
211			done = true
212			return
213		var n := cur_n
214		var late := pos_now()
215		var exp_t := expected_time(n)
216		var ph := phase(n)
217		var frame := scoot_sprite.frame
218		var lo := lower.scale
219		var up := upper.position
220		var us := upper.scale
221		var ok_a := absf(late - exp_t) <= TOL_T   # false for NAN
222		var ok_b := false
223		var exp_str := ""
224		var exp_cell := -1
225		var rig_diff := 0.0
226		if spec["clip"] == "scoot":
227			exp_cell = 0 if posmod(ph, 14) < 7 else 1
228			ok_b = frame == exp_cell
229			exp_str = "exp_frame=%d exp_cell=%d" % [posmod(ph, 14), exp_cell]
230		else:
231			var el: Vector2 = land_anim.value_track_interpolate(tr_lower, exp_t)
232			var eu: Vector2 = land_anim.value_track_interpolate(tr_upos, exp_t)
233			var es: Vector2 = land_anim.value_track_interpolate(tr_uscale, exp_t)
234			rig_diff = maxf(maxf(absf(lo.x - el.x), absf(lo.y - el.y)), maxf(maxf(absf(up.x - eu.x), absf(up.y - eu.y)), maxf(absf(us.x - es.x), absf(us.y - es.y))))
235			ok_b = rig_diff <= TOL_V
236			exp_str = "exp_frame=%d exp_lower=%s exp_upos=%s exp_uscale=%s rig_maxdiff=%.9f" % [mini(ph, 8), v2s(el), v2s(eu), v2s(es), rig_diff]
237		var paused := tick_paused(n)
238		var cnt := counted(n)
239		var line := "TICK run=%s n=%d phys=%d c=%d call=%s paused=%s counted=%s early=%.12f mid=%.12f late=%.12f cur=\"%s\" assigned=\"%s\" playing=%s frame=%d lower_scale=%s upper_pos=%s upper_scale=%s exp_t=%.12f %s ok_a=%s ok_b=%s" % [
240			run_id, n, tick, logical_c(n), call_name, paused, cnt, early, mid, late,
241			String(ap.current_animation), String(ap.assigned_animation), ap.is_playing(), frame,
242			v2s(lo), v2s(up), v2s(us), exp_t, exp_str, ok_a, ok_b]
243		print(line)
244		ticks_logged += 1
245		rows.append({"n": n, "early": early, "early_playing": early_playing, "mid": mid, "mid_frame": mid_frame,
246			"mid_lower": mid_lower, "late": late, "call": call_name, "paused": paused, "counted": cnt,
247			"exp_t": exp_t, "phase": ph, "frame": frame, "exp_cell": exp_cell, "lower": lo, "upos": up, "uscale": us,
248			"rig_diff": rig_diff, "ok_a": ok_a, "ok_b": ok_b, "cur": String(ap.current_animation),
249			"assigned": String(ap.assigned_animation), "playing": ap.is_playing(), "line": line})
250		if n >= last_n():
251			done = true
252	
253	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- runs
254	
255	func make_specs() -> Array[Dictionary]:
256		var out: Array[Dictionary] = []
257		for m in ["R1", "R2"]:
258			for k in range(14):
259				out.append({"clip": "scoot", "method": m, "k": k, "pause": -1})
260		out.append({"clip": "scoot", "method": "R3", "k": 0, "pause": -1})
261		for m in ["R1", "R2"]:
262			for k in [0, 3]:
263				out.append({"clip": "land", "method": m, "k": k, "pause": -1})
264		out.append({"clip": "land", "method": "R3", "k": 0, "pause": -1})
265		# Pause: R1 and R2 only (R3 is play() alone at t = 0 and cannot seek to a synced resume time).
266		for m in ["R1", "R2"]:
267			out.append({"clip": "scoot", "method": m, "k": 0, "pause": 7})    # frozen at 6/60, resume at 7/60
268			out.append({"clip": "scoot", "method": m, "k": 0, "pause": 20})   # after a wrap: frozen at 5/60, resume at 6/60
269			out.append({"clip": "land", "method": m, "k": 0, "pause": 3})     # frozen at 2/60, resume at 3/60
270		# Hand-off: land playing (7/60 at n = -1), then on n = 0 switch to scoot at k/60 in one stand-in tick.
271		for m in ["H0", "H1", "H2"]:
272			for k in range(14):
273				out.append({"clip": "scoot", "method": m, "k": k, "pause": -1, "handoff": true})
274		return out
275	
276	func do_run(sp: Dictionary) -> bool:
277		spec = sp
278		run_id = "%s-%s-k%02d%s" % ["handoff" if bool(sp.get("handoff", false)) else sp["clip"], sp["method"], int(sp["k"]), ("-pause%d" % int(sp["pause"])) if int(sp["pause"]) >= 0 else ""]
279		rows.clear()
280		pre_cur = ""
281		pre_late = NAN
282		done = false
283		active = false
284		cur_n = -999
285		early_stamp = -1
286		var scene := load(SCENE_PATH) as PackedScene
287		if scene == null:
288			harness_fail("cannot load " + SCENE_PATH)
289			return false
290		visuals = scene.instantiate() as Node2D
291		if visuals == null:
292			harness_fail("scene root is not a Node2D")
293			return false
294		ap = visuals.get_node_or_null("AnimationPlayer") as AnimationPlayer
295		scoot_sprite = visuals.get_node_or_null("FacingPivot/Scoot/ScootSprite") as Sprite2D
296		lower = visuals.get_node_or_null("FacingPivot/LandRig/LowerPivot") as Node2D
297		upper = visuals.get_node_or_null("FacingPivot/LandRig/UpperPivot") as Node2D
298		if ap == null or scoot_sprite == null or lower == null or upper == null:
299			harness_fail("missing node: ap=%s scoot_sprite=%s lower=%s upper=%s" % [ap != null, scoot_sprite != null, lower != null, upper != null])
300			visuals.free()
301			return false
302		if not ap.has_animation(&"scoot") or not ap.has_animation(&"land"):
303			harness_fail("missing clip: scoot=%s land=%s" % [ap.has_animation(&"scoot"), ap.has_animation(&"land")])
304			visuals.free()
305			return false
306		land_anim = ap.get_animation(&"land")
307		scoot_len = ap.get_animation(&"scoot").length
308		tr_lower = land_anim.find_track(NodePath(LOWER_SCALE_PATH), Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
309		tr_upos = land_anim.find_track(NodePath(UPPER_POS_PATH), Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
310		tr_uscale = land_anim.find_track(NodePath(UPPER_SCALE_PATH), Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
311		if tr_lower < 0 or tr_upos < 0 or tr_uscale < 0:
312			harness_fail("missing land track: %d %d %d" % [tr_lower, tr_upos, tr_uscale])
313			visuals.free()
314			return false
315		stand = StandIn.new()
316		stand.name = "StandIn"
317		stand.process_physics_priority = 0
318		stand.on_tick = _stand_tick
319		stand.add_child(visuals)
320		if runs_done == 0:
321			print("SETUP callback_mode_process=%d (PHYSICS=%d) physics_ticks_per_second=%d physics_delta=%.12f ap_priority=%d playervisuals_priority=%d standin_priority=%d hook_priority=%d scoot_length=%.12f land_length=%.12f" % [
322				ap.callback_mode_process, AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS, Engine.physics_ticks_per_second,
323				1.0 / Engine.physics_ticks_per_second, ap.process_physics_priority, visuals.process_physics_priority,
324				stand.process_physics_priority, hook.process_physics_priority, scoot_len, land_anim.length])
325		print("RUN %s clip=%s method=%s k=%d pause=%d handoff=%s start_phys=%d start_frame=%d" % [run_id, sp["clip"], sp["method"], int(sp["k"]), int(sp["pause"]), bool(sp.get("handoff", false)), Engine.get_physics_frames(), Engine.get_process_frames()])
326		active = true
327		root.add_child(stand)
328		var guard := 0
329		while not done and guard < 400:
330			await physics_frame
331			guard += 1
332		active = false
333		var ok := done and not harness_failed
334		if not done:
335			harness_fail("run %s did not finish in 400 physics ticks" % run_id)
336		elif ok:
337			if rows.size() != last_n() + 1:
338				harness_fail("run %s logged %d rows, expected %d" % [run_id, rows.size(), last_n() + 1])
339				ok = false

	if visuals == null:

		if clip != &"":

	anim.seek(_clip_time(want), true)

	return float(tick % (2 * T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME))) / CLIP_FPS

extends CharacterBody2D
## The jelly. Movement model from the walker-jumpman starter (unchanged rules: fixed jump,
## coyote and buffer ticks, a held jump never re-jumps); sizes from CHARACTER-SHEET.md.

const Tuning = preload("res://features/player/tuning.gd")
const T = preload("res://game/slice_tuning.gd")
const POSES := ["IDLE", "BORED", "SCOOT-A", "SCOOT-B", "ANTIC", "RISE", "FALL", "LAND", "WORRY", "SPLAT", "RESPAWN", "CELEBRATE"]
## CHARACTER-SHEET.md gives the crouch, landing squash and bored slump the low box. In this build
## the crouch (ANTIC) is a visual-only pose shown after takeoff, so it keeps the standing box:
## a low box in the air let the jelly rise 14 px higher into a ceiling (starter low-ceiling check).
const LOW_POSES := ["LAND", "BORED"]
const STANDING := Vector2(52, 58)   # CHARACTER-SHEET.md: bottom-aligned, centred
const LOW := Vector2(52, 44)
var tuning = Tuning.new()
var enabled: bool = false
var tick: int = 0
var last_floor_tick: int = -1000
var jump_request_tick: int = -1000
var opportunity_consumed: bool = false
var require_jump_release: bool = true
var require_axis_release: bool = true   # a direction held through a lock is ignored until released
var ignore_press_through_frame: int = -1
var facing: float = 1.0
var jumps: int = 0
var was_grounded: bool = true
var just_landed: bool = false
var just_hopped: bool = false
var box: Vector2 = STANDING
var collider: CollisionShape2D
var sprite: Sprite2D
var textures: Dictionary = {}
var pose: String = "IDLE"
var override_pose: String = ""   # set by the session: SPLAT, RESPAWN or CELEBRATE
var worried: bool = false        # set by the session: a shadow is growing over this plate
var idle_ticks: int = 0
var land_ticks: int = 0
var hop_ticks: int = -1          # ticks since takeoff; -1 when the jelly did not hop
var sound: Node                  # the session's sound-event entry point
var test_control: bool = false
var test_axis: float = 0.0
var test_jump_pressed: bool = false
var test_jump_held: bool = false

func _ready() -> void:
	name = "Player"
	collision_layer = 2
	collision_mask = 1
	floor_snap_length = 2.0
	collider = CollisionShape2D.new()
	collider.shape = RectangleShape2D.new()
	add_child(collider)
	set_box(STANDING)
	for p in POSES:
		textures[p] = load("res://assets/art/CHAR-%s.png" % p)
	# Every pose's bottom edge is at y 811-812 of its 1024 canvas: anchor at bottom centre.
	sprite = Sprite2D.new()
	sprite.centered = false
	sprite.offset = -T.JELLY_ANCHOR
	sprite.scale = Vector2.ONE * T.JELLY_SCALE
	sprite.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS
	add_child(sprite)
	_update_pose()

func set_box(size: Vector2) -> void:
	box = size
	(collider.shape as RectangleShape2D).size = size
	collider.position = Vector2(0, -size.y / 2.0)

func reset_at(spawn: Vector2) -> void:
	position = spawn
	velocity = Vector2.ZERO
	last_floor_tick = -1000
	jumps = 0
	was_grounded = true   # placing the jelly on a plate is not a landing
	just_landed = false
	just_hopped = false
	idle_ticks = 0
	land_ticks = 0
	hop_ticks = -1
	require_fresh_press()
	_update_pose()

func require_fresh_press() -> void:
	## The next hop needs a new jump press: a held key must be released first, and a press
	## that arrived with the key that changed the state (skip, restart, unpause) is ignored.
	## A held direction is ignored the same way, so the skip or restart key never moves the jelly.
	require_jump_release = true
	require_axis_release = true
	jump_request_tick = -1000
	opportunity_consumed = false
	test_jump_pressed = false
	ignore_press_through_frame = Engine.get_physics_frames() + 1

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
	just_landed = false
	just_hopped = false
	if not enabled:
		_update_pose()
		return
	tick += 1
	var axis := test_axis if test_control else Input.get_axis("move_left", "move_right")
	if is_zero_approx(axis):
		require_axis_release = false
	elif require_axis_release:
		axis = 0.0
	var held := test_jump_held if test_control else Input.is_action_pressed("jump")
	var pressed := test_jump_pressed if test_control else Input.is_action_just_pressed("jump")
	test_jump_pressed = false
	if pressed and Engine.get_physics_frames() <= ignore_press_through_frame:
		pressed = false
	idle_ticks = 0 if (not is_zero_approx(axis) or held or pressed) else idle_ticks + 1
	if not held:
		require_jump_release = false
	if is_on_floor() and velocity.y >= 0.0:
		last_floor_tick = tick
		opportunity_consumed = false
	if pressed and not require_jump_release:
		jump_request_tick = tick
	var rate: float = tuning.acceleration if not is_zero_approx(axis) else tuning.deceleration
	velocity.x = move_toward(velocity.x, axis * tuning.speed, rate * delta)
	if not is_zero_approx(axis):
		facing = signf(axis)
	velocity.y = minf(velocity.y + tuning.gravity * delta, tuning.terminal_velocity)
	if not opportunity_consumed and tick - last_floor_tick <= tuning.coyote_ticks and tick - jump_request_tick <= tuning.buffer_ticks:
		velocity.y = tuning.jump_velocity
		opportunity_consumed = true
		jump_request_tick = -1000
		jumps += 1
		just_hopped = true
		hop_ticks = 0
		# Grounded (or coyote) -> airborne after a fresh jump press: the only place SFX-HOP plays.
		if sound:
			sound.play("SFX-HOP")
	move_and_slide()
	var grounded := is_on_floor()
	if grounded and not was_grounded:
		just_landed = true
		land_ticks = T.LAND_TICKS
		hop_ticks = -1
	elif land_ticks > 0:
		land_ticks -= 1
	if not grounded and hop_ticks >= 0:
		hop_ticks += 1
	was_grounded = grounded
	_update_pose()

func choose_pose() -> String:
	## CHARACTER-SHEET.md pose table. Worried always overrides bored.
	if override_pose != "":
		return override_pose
	if not was_grounded:
		if hop_ticks >= 0 and hop_ticks <= T.ANTIC_TICKS:
			return "ANTIC"   # visual only: shown at takeoff, no input delay
		return "RISE" if velocity.y < 0.0 else "FALL"
	if land_ticks > 0:
		return "LAND"
	if absf(velocity.x) > 8.0:
		return "SCOOT-A" if (tick / T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME)) % 2 == 0 else "SCOOT-B"
	if worried:
		return "WORRY"
	if idle_ticks >= T.ticks(T.BORED_DELAY):
		return "BORED"
	return "IDLE"

func _update_pose() -> void:
	pose = choose_pose()
	sprite.texture = textures[pose]
	sprite.flip_h = facing < 0.0   # drawn facing right; keeps the last direction moved
	var wanted := LOW if pose in LOW_POSES else STANDING
	if wanted != box:
		set_box(wanted)
	_update_visuals()

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- A7 visual layer
## CHANGE-BRIEF.md (A7), "Scene, authority and states" and Revision 1. Everything below only reads
## gameplay state (pose, facing, tick, land_ticks, just_landed, enabled); it never writes it.
## The AnimationPlayer alone writes ScootSprite.frame and the rig pivots; this code writes only the
## facing mirror, the three visibility flags and the playback calls.

const VISUALS_SCENE = preload("res://features/player/player_visuals.tscn")
## Pose -> clip. Every other pose shows the original sprite with no clip.
const POSE_CLIPS := {"LAND": &"land", "SCOOT-A": &"scoot", "SCOOT-B": &"scoot"}
const CLIP_FPS := 60.0   # both clips: step 1/60 s, one physics tick per timeline frame

var visuals: Node2D
var facing_pivot: Node2D
var scoot_node: Node2D
var land_rig: Node2D
var anim: AnimationPlayer
var clip: StringName = &""        # the clip this code last entered, or "" for the original sprite
var clip_held: bool = false       # the player was disabled with a clip selected: re-enter when enabled

func _update_visuals() -> void:
	if visuals == null:
		visuals = VISUALS_SCENE.instantiate()
		add_child(visuals)
		facing_pivot = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot")
		scoot_node = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot/Scoot")
		land_rig = visuals.get_node("FacingPivot/LandRig")
		anim = visuals.get_node("AnimationPlayer")
	facing_pivot.transform = Transform2D(Vector2(facing, 0), Vector2(0, 1), Vector2.ZERO)
	var want: StringName = POSE_CLIPS.get(pose, &"")
	scoot_node.visible = want == &"scoot"
	land_rig.visible = want == &"land"
	sprite.visible = want == &""
	if want == &"":
		# Leaving a clip (hop, walk-off, override, tick-8 hand-off, reset): stop it.
		if clip != &"":
			anim.stop()
		clip = &""
		clip_held = false
		return
	if not enabled:
		# Paused or locked with a clip selected: freeze it; it re-enters on the first enabled tick.
		if clip != want and clip != &"":
			anim.stop()
		clip = want
		if anim.is_playing():
			anim.pause()
		clip_held = true
		return
	var entry := want != clip or clip_held or (want == &"land" and just_landed)
	if not entry:
		return   # steady tick, including SCOOT-A <-> SCOOT-B: no call
	if clip != &"" and clip != want:
		anim.stop()
	anim.play(want)
	anim.seek(_clip_time(want), true)
	clip = want
	clip_held = false

func _clip_time(c: StringName) -> float:
	## The synced entry time: LAND (8 - land_ticks) / 60, SCOOT (tick % 14) / 60.
	if c == &"land":
		return float(T.LAND_TICKS - land_ticks) / CLIP_FPS
	return float(tick % (2 * T.ticks(T.SCOOT_FRAME))) / CLIP_FPS

Fix A is in, and nothing stopped me. H3 passed at all three rates, so I changed the one entry in player.gd. The state test is now 132 checks / 0 failures at 30, 60 and 144 (it was 132 / 5). Pin counts, PINDIGESTs, baseline counts and both read-backs are unchanged. Nothing is staged or committed.

## 1. H3 probe results

H3 does what player.gd did at the switch (`stop()`, then `play(&"scoot")`), but seeks to `fposmod(k/60 − 1/60, scoot.length)`. It ran for every phase k = 0..13. Each run checks the switch tick plus the 31 ticks after it, so 14 × 32 = 448 ticks per rate. The time check (a) uses circular distance on the loop, and only for H3; R1–H2 are scored exactly as before.

| Rate | H3 result line | Failing runs | Clip time on switch tick minus k/60 | Ticks expected at 7/60 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 | `H3VERDICT runs=14 ticks_checked=448 (required 448) ticks_failing_a=0 ticks_failing_b=0 pass=yes` | 0 of 14 | 0.000000 in all 14 | 32, all cell 1 |
| 60 | same | 0 of 14 | 0.000000 in all 14 | 32, all cell 1 |
| 144 | same | 0 of 14 | 0.000000 in all 14 | 32, all cell 1 |

- **k = 0:** at 30 fps the log shows `seek_s=0.216666663333` (13/60), then `entry_late=0.000000000000 entry_frame=0` (`probe_a7_entry_order_30fps.log:4946`). So it reads 0, not one tick ahead. The 60 and 144 runs passed the same check on every tick (all 0 failures).
- **Old variants for comparison:** H0, H1 and H2 still fail 448/448 ticks on time at every rate, as in fd4d855.
- **Fresh entries:** R1 still passes 593/593 ticks at every rate.

## 2. player.gd diff

```diff
@@ -225,7 +225,13 @@ func _update_visuals() -> void:
 	if clip != &"" and clip != want:
 		anim.stop()
 	anim.play(want)
-	anim.seek(_clip_time(want), true)
+	if clip == &"land" and want == &"scoot" and not clip_held:
+		# Direct LAND -> SCOOT switch: the AnimationPlayer was already playing land, and its own update
+		# later this tick adds 1/60 (fd4d855). Seek one tick earlier on the loop so it lands on the synced time
+		# (probe H3, prompt-5e).
+		anim.seek(fposmod(_clip_time(want) - 1.0 / CLIP_FPS, anim.get_animation(&"scoot").length), true)
+	else:
```
